lines.de: Sound familiar? Three Linux machines, three updates.
lines.en: Sound familiar? Three Linux machines, three updates.

lines.de: And each one downloads the same packages from the internet again.
lines.en: And each one downloads the same packages from the internet again.

lines.de: Cache & Carry solves this.
lines.en: Cache & Carry solves this.

lines.de: The first machine downloads a package from the internet.
lines.en: The first machine downloads a package from the internet.

lines.de: All others get it straight from your network.
lines.en: All others get it straight from your network.

lines.de: Live traffic shows it exactly.
lines.en: Live traffic shows it exactly.

lines.de: On the first request the package comes from the internet.
lines.en: On the first request the package comes from the internet.

lines.de: For the next machine it comes from the cache.
lines.en: For the next machine it comes from the cache.

lines.de: Cache & Carry is a lean, self-hosted package cache for your network.
lines.en: Cache & Carry is a lean, self-hosted package cache for your network.

lines.de: For APT and Pacman, with a dashboard, statistics and storage limits.
lines.en: For APT and Pacman, with a dashboard, statistics and storage limits.

lines.de: Free and open source.
lines.en: Free and open source.

lines.de: You can install it in three ways. All with the same version.
lines.en: You can install it in three ways. All with the same version.

lines.de: One: Proxmox VE.
lines.en: One: Proxmox VE.

lines.de: One command on the host creates an unprivileged Debian container, verifies the checksum and installs the latest release.
lines.en: One command on the host creates an unprivileged Debian container, verifies the checksum and installs the latest release.

lines.de: At the end you see the address and the setup token.
lines.en: At the end you see the address and the setup token.

lines.de: An update is the same command with update and the container number.
lines.en: An update is the same command with update and the container number.

lines.de: Two: Docker.
lines.en: Two: Docker.

lines.de: The image is available for amd64 and arm64. It is smaller than 16 megabytes and contains no shell.
lines.en: The image is available for amd64 and arm64. It is smaller than 16 megabytes and contains no shell.

lines.de: A single Docker command is enough.
lines.en: A single Docker command is enough.

lines.de: Three: Debian or Ubuntu.
lines.en: Three: Debian or Ubuntu.

lines.de: Download the package from the release, unpack it and run the install script.
lines.en: Download the package from the release, unpack it and run the install script.

lines.de: Cache & Carry then runs as a systemd service, also in a VM or on a Raspberry Pi.
lines.en: Cache & Carry then runs as a systemd service, also in a VM or on a Raspberry Pi.

lines.de: To update, run the script again with the new version.
lines.en: To update, run the script again with the new version.

lines.de: Then open the web interface on port 8080.
lines.en: Then open the web interface on port 8080.

lines.de: Enter the token, choose a password, done.
lines.en: Enter the token, choose a password, done.

lines.de: You will find all commands on the website and on GitHub.
lines.en: You will find all commands on the website and on GitHub.

lines.de: Cache & Carry is open source. Feel free to leave a star.
lines.en: Cache & Carry is open source. Feel free to leave a star.

lines.de: If this video helps you: subscribe to the channel, leave a like and tell me in the comments how you use it.
lines.en: If this video helps you: subscribe to the channel, leave a like and tell me in the comments how you use it.
